sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Make Amends - Sweep Up is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Friend, now is not the time to spoil relations with influential people. Lightkeeper told me about your conflicts. He offers a deal - you help his allies with their personal problems, and he forgets old grudges. We need to eliminate a group of Raiders encroaching on Rogue territory. You'll have to sweep their ranks at the federal reserve base. Can you do that?"

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
"Lightkeeper told me that you had completed the "request". Thank you."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to kill 25 Scav Raiders on Reserve.
